facts.fact: The single pinned source file publishes the complete numerical I0 seed, I1 seed and higher-integer-order program. The higher-order recurrence start is exactly2*(n+floor(sqrt(40*n))) for integer order n>=2. There is no division by2 inside that published start expression.

The higher-order method is backward three-term modified-Bessel-I recurrence with normalization by the source's own I0 seed. It uses fixed rescaling magnitude1e12 and rescaling factor1e-12. These are published source constants, not searched parameters.

The published I0 and I1 seeds separate argument magnitudes at3.75. Low-seed polynomials use the square of the quotient x/3.75; high-seed polynomials use3.75 divided by the argument magnitude, with exponential and square-root scaling. Their coefficients and arithmetic grouping are part of this complete candidate.

The source supplies zero-argument values and integer-order parity for negative arguments. Its numerical program supplies no measured Excel overflow-admission boundary. Existing product admission behavior is a separate obligation.
